title: $100 AI Music Video: Claude Fable 5 vs. GPT-5.6 Sol
summary: A practical benchmark test comparing Claude and GPT models' capabilities in creating AI-generated music videos with a $100 budget constraint, evaluating their real-world performance in a head-to-head arena competition.
problem_solved: Provides empirical comparison of leading AI models' music video generation capabilities under identical budget constraints
why_valuable: Offers practical, hands-on evaluation of AI model performance differences rather than theoretical specs, helping developers and enthusiasts make informed decisions about which AI system better suits their creative projects
